app.name: Gym Tracker
app.tagline: Follow your routine. See your progress.

legal.privacyBody: Gym Tracker stores the profile details, body metrics, and workout records you enter. This data is used solely to operate the app and to personalize your AI-generated routines. AI features run on self-hosted models, so your data is not sent to third-party AI providers. We keep your data while your account is active and remove it after deletion. You can export a copy of your data or delete your account at any time from the Profile page.
legal.termsBody: Gym Tracker is provided as-is, without warranties of any kind. The routines, metrics, and AI suggestions shown in the app are for general fitness tracking only and are not medical advice. Always consult a qualified professional before starting or changing an exercise program.
